A corrected candidate cannot silently retarget a listing bound to invalid evidence. PostgreSQL Plugin tests retain original inspection and approved evidence across checksum drift/recovery, reject sealed-version and stale-revision writes, and persist a changed archive under a new draft version without changing the published revision.
